name: Commando Plus
description: TEST BUILD: untested in game. Commando missions made a little more forgiving, each option in commando-plus.ini: no mission timer, free Resupply calls at the drop-in (0 to 2), extra uses of the Super Destroyer call-in, more stims and grenades in point-of-interest caches, and outpost caches: every enemy base cleared banks ammo boxes, called in by the Outpost Cache stratagems (a pod of 8, and a small one for the rest; in Commando while the Super Destroyer is overhead). The Super Destroyer stays 15 s longer for every base cleared (up to 3 minutes). resupply_to_pods 1 lands Resupplies at the Reinforcement Pods. every_mission 1 applies them to every mission. Host or solo.
